mapper.select: SELECT li.login_id AS loginId, COALESCE(li.login_attempt_count, 0) AS attemptCount, (li.locked_at IS NOT NULL) AS locked FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = li.login_id AND u.tenant_id = li.tenant_id WHERE li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND (li.login_code = #{id} OR u.email_addr = #{id}) AND COALESCE(li.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY (li.login_code = #{id}) DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_login_account SET login_attempt_count = COALESCE(login_attempt_count, 0) + 1, locked_at = CASE WHEN COALESCE(login_attempt_count, 0) + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN COALESCE(locked_at, now()) ELSE locked_at END WHERE tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND login_id = #{loginId}
UPDATE tb_login_account SET login_attempt_count = 0 WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND COALESCE(login_attempt_count, 0) <> 0
mapper.select: SELECT (li.password_change_required = 'Y') FROM tb_login_account li WHERE li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND li.login_code = #{loginCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = li.login_id AND u.tenant_id = li.tenant_id WHERE li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND li.login_code = #{loginCode} AND COALESCE(li.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NOT (u.retire_dt IS NOT NULL AND u.retire_dt <= CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT li.login_code AS id FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = li.login_id WHERE u.user_nm = #{name} AND u.email_addr = #{email}
AND li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint)
AND li.tenant_id = ( SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 )
AND COALESCE(li.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY li.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT li.password_hash AS password FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = li.login_id WHERE li.login_code = #{id} AND u.user_nm = #{name} AND u.email_addr = #{email}
AND li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint)
AND li.tenant_id = ( SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 )
AND COALESCE(li.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y'

SELECT li.login_code FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = li.login_id WHERE li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND u.email_addr = #{email} AND COALESCE(li.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY li.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT li.login_code AS userId, u.user_id AS employeeId, u.user_nm AS name, u.email_addr AS email, d.department_nm AS departmentName, lvl.item_nm AS levelName, li.profile_image AS profileImage, li.stamp_image AS stampImage, u.employee_no AS employeeNo, pi.item_nm AS positionNm FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = li.login_id AND u.tenant_id = li.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id AND d.tenant_id = li.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group pg ON pg.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND pg.group_code = 'POSITION' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item pi ON pi.group_id = pg.common_code_group_id AND pi.item_code = u.position_code LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group lg ON lg.tenant_id = li.tenant_id AND lg.group_code = 'LEVEL' AND COALESCE(lg.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item lvl ON lvl.common_code_item_id = u.level_id AND lvl.group_id = lg.common_code_group_id AND lvl.tenant_id = li.tenant_id AND COALESCE(lvl.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' WHERE li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND li.login_code = #{loginCode} AND COALESCE(li.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NOT (u.retire_dt IS NOT NULL AND u.retire_dt <= CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 1
SELECT password_hash FROM tb_login_account WHERE tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND login_code = #{loginCode} AND COALESCE(use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user u SET email_addr = #{email}, updated_at = now() FROM tb_login_account li WHERE li.login_id = u.login_id AND li.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND li.login_code = #{loginCode}

UPDATE tb_user u SET photo_image = #{profileImage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = now() FROM tb_login_account li WHERE li.login_id = u.login_id AND li.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND li.login_code = #{loginCode}
UPDATE tb_login_account SET profile_image = #{profileImage}, stamp_image = #{stampImage}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND login_code = #{loginCode}

UPDATE tb_login_account SET password_hash = #{password}, password_changed_at = now(), password_change_required = 'N', updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND login_code = #{loginCode}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{value} AND COALESCE(use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' LIMIT 1
